THIRD-PARTY RUNTIME NOTICES - LOCAL REVIEW PACKAGE

The adjacent unaltered license texts cover the reviewed CPython 3.11.9 Windows
runtime, Tcl/Tk 8.6.12, OpenSSL 3.0.13 and PyInstaller 6.22.3. Python's license
file also contains notices for bundled library components and Windows binaries.
notice-sources.json records origin/version and SHA256 for each copied text.

PyInstaller bootloader and runtime-hook notices are preserved in its COPYING
file. These notices do not license TechPartner's own application source or
change its ownership. No dependency source was modified by this packaging work.

The isolated build embeds these files and includes a readable adjacent copy.
build-manifest.json inventories actual bundled binaries and package files.
This package is unsigned, intended for local review, and has not passed clean
Windows machine acceptance. Do not treat these notices as release approval.
